title: ze_visualizer
description: Six levels of particles, by Madara. Level 5 ends under falling balls; level 6 ends in the Blue Particle (16 segments, 22 attacks of track lasers, rotating beams, sphere rings and laser fans) and a final dodge of shots rising from below.

scenarios.name: Level 5 ending: falling balls
scenarios.summary: Ride the platform, dodge falling balls
scenarios.description: Ride the ending platform (le5_movelinear_end, 7.5 s). On arrival l5_ending_relay drops two then four lines of balls from above every 0.15 s (12–20 s, l5_ball_end_hurt: instant kill) while the cube dodge sweeps the platform (stage5ending_hurt: 800). Win when s5_once_win turns on at +22 s.

scenarios.name: Blue Particle (boss)
scenarios.summary: Blue Particle boss: 22 random attacks
scenarios.description: main_boss_start_relay: the boss spawns over the room, boss_add_hp gives each human 90 hits per segment (16 segments, boss_healthcount), and 123_boss_case_attack_main picks one of 22 attacks after each one ends. stage6_playerboss_hp sets 160 HP. Win when boss_death_relay fires (its 16th segment).

scenarios.name: Final dodge (after the boss)
scenarios.summary: The floor breaks: dodge shots from below
scenarios.description: From the boss's death: the floor breaks under you at +61 s and final_dodge_relay fires 43 s of shots rising from ~3000 u below (look down): l6 balls (instant kill), l7 balls (180), l8 beams (120), the l9 beam spray (instant kill) and l10 rings every 2–4 s (instant kill). Then the floor breaks again; win on the humans-win trigger the fall reaches.

scenarios.name: Attack 1: track lasers
scenarios.summary: Track lasers and spheres cross the room
scenarios.description: first_attack_maker pairs send track lasers (1_hurt: 20) and spheres (newsphere_hurt: 20) across the room at 0, 2, 4 and 6 s (makers 1+3, 7+8, 4+5, 8+7).

scenarios.name: Attack 1b: track lasers
scenarios.summary: Track lasers, the other order
scenarios.description: The other order of attack 1: makers 4+5, 6+9, 3+1, 4+5 at 0, 2, 4 and 6 s.

scenarios.name: Attack 2: floor spheres
scenarios.summary: Spheres rolling along the floor
scenarios.description: Six second_makers drop spheres along the floor (2_hurt: 40), then track lasers at 12.5 s.

scenarios.name: Attack 3: side spheres
scenarios.summary: Side lasers from racing spheres
scenarios.description: Two mini spheres run the sides on tracktrains (600 u/s) and fire side lasers (3_1_hurt: 40, 3_2_hurt: 30) every 1.3–2.6 s for 8.5 s; track lasers at 13.5 and 15.5 s.

scenarios.name: Attack 4: sweeping lasers
scenarios.summary: A wall of sweeping lasers
scenarios.description: fourth_attack_template: a door (512 u at 400 u/s) carries 10 makers of sweeping lasers (4_1_hurt: 30).

scenarios.name: Attack 5: twin sphere rings
scenarios.summary: Rings of spheres from two orbiters
scenarios.description: Two spheres circle on tracktrains and spit rings of spheres (newsphere_hurt: 20) every 0.13 s (4.7–10 s, then 15–19.5 s); track lasers at 23 s. The longest attack.

scenarios.name: Attack 6: push or gravity
scenarios.summary: A push or a pull, then lasers
scenarios.description: boss_six_random_case: a push or a gravity pull, then track lasers at 4.15 s.

scenarios.name: Attack 7: NPC drops
scenarios.summary: Dodge NPCs dropping into the room
scenarios.description: boss_seven_timer drops NPCs (npc_hurt: 40) at one of six spawnpoints every 1.5–3.3 s for 10 s.

scenarios.name: Attack 8: laser wall
scenarios.summary: Jump the descending laser wall
scenarios.description: height_attack_template: a door (328 u down at 600 u/s) with 19 makers of wall lasers (8_laserhurt1: 20); track lasers at 14 and 15 s.

scenarios.name: Attack 9: track pairs
scenarios.summary: Two of four tracks fire at once
scenarios.description: nine_track_case fires two of four tracks every 2 s from 2 to 12 s (9_hurt: 30).

scenarios.name: Attack 10: laser fan
scenarios.summary: A fan of eight lasers sweeps across
scenarios.description: ten_attack_maker sweeps a fan of 8 lasers 25° apart, one every 0.5 s, left or right (10_hurt: 60).

scenarios.name: Attack 11: rotating beam
scenarios.summary: One beam rotating around the room
scenarios.description: One beam turns around the room (11_rotating, 13°/s, 11_hurt: 60); track lasers at 20 s.

scenarios.name: Attack 12: yellow spheres
scenarios.summary: Dodge the yellow sphere barrage
scenarios.description: Two spheres ride tracktrains out (600 u/s) and fire yellow spheres (12_hurt: 40) every 0.1–0.4 s from 3 to 9 s.

scenarios.name: Attack 13: twin rotating beams
scenarios.summary: Two beams turning at different speeds
scenarios.description: Two beams turn at different speeds (15 and 35°/s, 13_hurt: 30 each).

scenarios.name: Attack 14: triple beam
scenarios.summary: Three hard-hitting beams on one rotator
scenarios.description: Three beams on one rotator (14°/s), 100 damage each.

scenarios.name: Attack 15: rotating NPCs
scenarios.summary: Rotating NPCs at two spawnpoints
scenarios.description: boss_fiveteen_random_case spawns rotating NPCs (rotating_npc_hurt: 30) at two of four spawnpoints.

scenarios.name: Attack 16: sphere train
scenarios.summary: A train throwing spheres
scenarios.description: sixteen_tracktrain carries a maker that throws spheres (16_hurt: 20) while a door moves 1000 u.

scenarios.name: Attack 17: falling lasers
scenarios.summary: Falling lasers on a rotator
scenarios.description: seventeen_rotating (45°/s) carries four makers of falling lasers (17_hurt1: 80).

scenarios.name: Attack 18: laser wall 2
scenarios.summary: Another descending laser wall
scenarios.description: heighteen_attack_template: a door (512 u at 400 u/s) with 19 makers of wall lasers (18_laserhurt1: 30).

scenarios.name: Attack 19: four beams
scenarios.summary: Four rotating beams
scenarios.description: 19_template: four rotating beams (14°/s, 19_beam_hurt: 60); track lasers at 22 s.

scenarios.name: Attack 20: sphere fan
scenarios.summary: A fan of spheres flung out
scenarios.description: twenty_case throws up to 16 spheres from twenty_maker, fanned 10–30° apart (12_hurt: 40); track lasers at 8 s.
